# finalproject

Final project for BST260, Fall 2026.

This repository contains an R package developed for the BST260 final
project at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.

The project includes statistical analysis, reproducible research, and
documentation using R and Quarto.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdcfiremort`](https://ziyiwang0113.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcfiremort.md)
  : data from CDC on rates of mortality by firearm by state by year
- [`cdcmurd`](https://ziyiwang0113.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcmurd.md)
  : data from CDC on homicide rates by state by year
- [`gunleg`](https://ziyiwang0113.github.io/finalproject/reference/gunleg.md)
  : data from RAND corporation on historical record of state
  legislatures actions on firearms control
- [`waterborne`](https://ziyiwang0113.github.io/finalproject/reference/waterborne.md)
  : data from CDC on waterborne and foodborne illness events
